# Apple Silicon

Apple's family of ARM-based system-on-a-chip (SoC) processors used in Mac computers, iPads, and iPhones. It features unified memory architecture, high-performance GPU cores, and the Apple Neural Engine. [[Álvaro Jiménez Martínez]] leveraged Apple Silicon for his mlx-modernbert project, implementing native [[MLX]] training of [[ModernBERT]] on Apple hardware. The project utilized optimizations such as fp16 mixed-precision, gradient checkpointing, and compiled computation graphs to reduce VRAM usage by 50% on Apple Silicon GPUs.
